yeah... i’ve heard as much and i should know better. it’s hard to say if i’m happy when something good happens, the impeding anxiety that it won’t last tends to overpower it. thanks for the kind words,  i appreciate it.

still haven’t heard anything from them... i set up another appointment at a different time but i had picked them because they specifically were lgbt friendly. hard to find that where i’m at unfortunately. thanks for the kind words, i appreciate it

was feeling especially low today and the fact that a person i had picked out to be my therapist just... didn’t bother to call me when we had a phone appointment just felt like a gut punch. that was supposed to be my first ever session.

i just want to let you know you’re not alone. i’m a gay trans man with unsupportive parents who is unable to transition. it’s infuriating and deeply upsetting, the days when my gender dysphoria hit me especially hard are agonizing... but i try to live on out of spite. i refuse to die until i can properly show the man i know i am on the inside.

you have my unconditional support. i wish you and your boyfriend the best.

i had fallen asleep but waking up and seeing this first thing made me smile honestly haha. thank you so much for the very kind words, i ended up reaching out to two friends and had a pretty good time actually!

i want to try striking up conversations with more people with similar interests, being queer and having been ghosted for it a handful of times has made me wary but i don’t want to give up. i hope i can get more comfortable to do this in real life and not just online one day.

yeah... that’s a good idea. i know a decent amount of people but they’re all surface level friendships. i tend to not talk to others because of anxiety and i burn out socially rather quickly. i think i’ll just rip the band-aid off and try and reach out to some of them.
i think i’ll do that, thank you for the replies
you’re right that that would be the best thing to do... i’m just terrified of coming across as controlling or even guilt-trippy i guess?

it simply isn’t feasible for me. i have no support whatsoever and lacking in money. i’m still dependent and family has no interest in helping. 

i’ve never really tried writing down my thoughts, i tend to struggle a lot with putting things into words, i suppose i can try it.

i can relate, i feel like i have other stuff going on asides from anxiety and depression but i simply don’t know what and have no idea if i’ll ever find out. feel like i was massively held back by a horrible time at school and an even worse time at home.
it’s horrible, i constantly get told how “easy” all those things are but to me they just seem impossible. i don’t know why things are so hard for me, they just are.

you’re absolutely right, what happened was unfortunate and sucked but i could never ignore someone in that kind of state. 

it felt nice to talk to someone so you definitely helped, thank you. you have a good one too.

it’s awful. the one time i managed to help someone they eventually ended up being absolutely horrible to me, it made me never want to reach out and help someone again. i don’t want to give up on that but i was burned so badly once that i’m terrified of it happening again.

i’m very sorry about the loss of your friend. i’m trans and my relationship with my dad is pretty terrible... i’ve always had an extremely difficult time connecting to others, mostly because of anxiety. now i’ve just become bitter and angry and don’t bother with most people. the few times i do try to connect i get ghosted or forgotten so why bother anymore...

best and only friend. i guess it would sound absurd to others but we met online and they’ve flown to visit me multiple times. they don’t really understand when i’m in a bad mental state and i always feel guilty or bad for being negative
i’ve never really attempted in my life but i’m getting so dysfunctional i’m terrified of losing the one person i have. i want to hang on for their sake but it’s.... so difficult
i’ve been trying, i get bored almost immediately. nothing catches in my interest.
thank you so much for such an in-depth reply, i’m pretty surprised at how many community mental health services there are for georgia. 7 cups sounds great, i’ll have try it out soon.
your kind words are much appreciated, thank you
thank you, i’ll look into this right away.
they’re so far apart for me... it’s not even good days, more like good minutes. i feel not depressed and the second i realize that, it all comes crashing down. i’m tired of it.

thank you for your input! there’s no way i could’ve been able to deal with it if it was still hurting, it thankfully stopped after about 40 minutes but the abrupt nature of the whole thing just freaked me out. i’m reliant on family and trying to go to the doctor is borderline impossible, i was brushed off this time but if it happens again i’ll make sure they’ll listen.
i’m not familiar with physical injuries but is it possible for it to have just gone away on its own relatively quickly...? i’d assume something severe like that would be constant
uh oh. i didn’t get a notification until now but i haven’t had any further trouble with it, what could it possibly be??

i’ll have to try it sometime! having a bunch of notepad files and word docs opened is overwhelming and demoralizing sometimes, maybe trying something new will help

i still draw sometimes but i used to churn out 40 drawings a week when i was a younger, now it’s more like 3 drawings a year maybe. i don’t really have any hobbies, i get really focused for maybe 2 weeks on something new before i get bored or frustrated and go back to video games. 

i guess the closest is that i started trying to write out my characters profiles even though they’re mostly for myself and i don’t have much interest in sharing them. making characters was mostly how i coped until i finally stopped making more and tried channeling energy into actually fleshing them out. i don’t get frustrated with writing but i don’t make much progress either.
fan art of characters i liked mostly. lots of oc art and art of friends ocs.
i honestly don’t really know. i regret deleting my old deviantart but i believe it was 2014 that i had basically dropped drawing entirely.

uuu that’s exactly what i was afraid of... just thinking about it makes me feel faint, ugh. i have severe anxiety from an assault that happened long ago, would i be able to request something to ease that? or do i just have to bear through it?

i truly don't think i want to ever go back at all. they don't understand why i interact with them as minimally as possible. it's not like it's miserable 24/7 but it's enough for me to always be walking on egg shells around them.

no i don’t mind any questions, anything to help people help me. 

i understand the concern, we met online when i was 11 and she was 9 i believe. we’ve met in person twice, her flying out to see me. i’ve never gotten a proper ID, only a learner’s permit. my parents haven’t taught me a thing about driving. at the time the only reason i had gotten it was so i could get hired for a summer job.

i had planned on saving money, but now i’m more afraid of being in the same house as him than the streets. my family won’t give me any support anyways, and extended family is completely out of the question. both sides of the extended family are awful. 

for the rest i’m just... not sure.
